## What will be wrong once #36721 merges
`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`, the "Refused when it does not compile" bullet (about lines 348-349 on main), ends: "A regex pattern the checking engine refuses is a warning: the runtime may accept it."

PR #36721 makes a regex pattern failure an `error` for action, hook and job bodies, except the two measured dialect gaps (a duplicate named capture group, a modifier group such as `(?i:a)`), which stay warnings. An agent loading the skill would be told a refused pattern only warns, and ship a body that the publish door now refuses.

## Ask
Rewrite that sentence to say what #36721's rule says: a pattern the runtime also refuses is refused at save, and only the two named dialect gaps warn. Keep the net line count flat (the skills token ratchet).

## Re-check
`grep -n "A regex pattern the checking engine refuses is a warning" skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`: a hit after #36721 merges means this card still applies.
